presentation.label: VEL HUMANISE
presentation.summary: Per track, every trig's velocity gets a random offset of up to ±N, set with FUNC + VEL on the TRIG page.
presentation.overview: Velocity Humanise gives each track a random velocity offset: every trig's velocity moves by a random amount up to ±N, clamped to 1..127. N is one of sixteen steps from 0 to 64, set by holding FUNC and turning VEL on the TRIG page, where the label reads RND and the knob becomes a sixteen-position selector. N is per pattern track, kept in core-ar2's mod storage and saved with the pattern. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0003-velocity-humanise, with his code unchanged apart from the storage port and FUNC + VEL's turn and text, which now go through core-ar2's parameter table (core_params) instead of two detours of his own.
highlights: FUNC + VEL sets a per-track random velocity range.
Sixteen steps from 0 to 64; 0 is stock behaviour.
Kept in core-ar2 mod storage and saved with the pattern.
No longer needs Euclid Accents in the same build.
usage: Use a build containing Velocity Humanise. On the TRIG page, hold FUNC and turn VEL: the label reads RND and the popup shows N.
Set N to 32 and play a track of equal-velocity trigs: the hits vary in level. Set N to 0: they are equal again.
Release FUNC: VEL is the trig velocity again, unchanged.

access.location: TRIG page: the VEL knob with FUNC held.
steps: Hold FUNC and turn VEL to set N.

controls.name: FUNC + VEL (TRIG page)
controls.doc: Sets the track's random velocity range N: sixteen steps from 0 to 64. Each trig's velocity moves by a random amount up to ±N, clamped to 1..127.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only. 1.2.0 reaches its parameter through core-ar2's parameter table (core_params, core-ar2 0.4 and later; Modwerk's base is core-ar2 0.7). 1.1.0 detoured the entries of param_apply_delta and param_value_text itself, which core-ar2 0.4 and later own, so it does not link with them.
Needs core-ar2's mod storage: four bits per pattern track (vel_rnd).
On stock firmware, or a build without this module, the track plays its plain velocities: N is in mod storage, which stock ignores.

Not beside Sample RATE: both patch the start of param_short_name (0x400a9000), the knob label routine, for different parameters (VEL here, FIN there). Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7) has no shared hook for labels; core-ar2 0.10's knob-name service would let them share.

load.display: Small: a storage read, a random draw and a clamp on each trig
load.conditions: Static: one detour runs per trig in the sequencer; it reads the track's N through core_store_get, which masks interrupts briefly, then draws and clamps the offset. The others run on UI edits and drawing. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: Iced-Cream reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74 and this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7, plain variant ba530f45, with analoghealth 1.3 for remote keys and the other module of the pair), build MW12, 2026-11-07 (runs T170-T172): FUNC + VEL on CP's TRIG page read RND and reached N 64, VEL alone stayed stock (screen); with 16 CP trigs, a 10 s take of CP's output (RS/CP channel) showed 61 hits with a peak spread of 3.7 dB (std) and 13.0 dB range, 4.7 dB on average from hit to hit (equal velocities measured about 0.35 dB in the 1.1 runs); N 64 was kept across a hand power cycle with no save. No dropouts; CPU 74-80 %, heap flat. Earlier runs (1.2 on core-ar2 0.4, 1.1 on 0.3) are in TESTING.md.
limitations: MW12: .syx 0d0517eac360cb1282704750b37dfbd1c3c3c13e411f13a52f82ed87eb9b69cd, built by scripts/link-image.mjs from this folder; firmware was not read back from the device.
MW12 also carried Euclid Accents 1.2.0 and analoghealth 1.3 (remote keys; no site shared with this module).
P4A4: .syx 1c0311697543789316c10dbbbfa78b9a717a180eb26611f2f0d1b732a428d65c. U4A4: .syx 18681f8709242b9d3c5117335a81cd5659ea01c583e3e8477d536e379517b785. Firmware was not read back from the device.
The playback checks of the random velocity spread 1.1 passed were not repeated on 1.2.

tests.summary: Hardware on Modwerk's base (MW12, 2026-11-07): N 64 spread 3.7 dB std, kept across a power cycle. Hardware: velocity-humanise 1.2 on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, with core-ar2 0.4 and the other rytm2_mods ports (P4A4, 2026-10-21): FUNC + VEL reads RND and steps through N's sixteen values, VEL alone is stock, and N survives a power-cycle without a project save. Modwerk's package linked with core-ar2 0.7 gives a main OS byte-identical to the rytm2_mods v1.3 release object linked with it. In the emulator on the Modwerk base (VH12), FUNC relabels VEL as RND and turning it shows N.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial
steps: Use a build containing Velocity Humanise. On the TRIG page, hold FUNC and turn VEL: the label reads RND and the popup shows N.

Release FUNC: VEL is the trig velocity again, unchanged.
